title: The Last Sheaf (A Song)
author: Sung in the Vale
pages: Cut the corn and bind the corn, and lay it on the cart. But leave the last sheaf standing, love, it is the harvest's heart. Oh leave the last sheaf standing.
We'll weave her arms of barley, love, and crown her head with rye. We'll hang her by the hearthstone where the winter can't come by. Oh hang her by the hearthstone.
And when the snow is on the hills and all the barns are thin, the Last Sheaf keeps the hunger out and keeps the summer in. Oh keep the summer in.
Come Seedtide we will take her down and scatter her in spring. And what she gave, we give her back, for that's the turning ring. Oh that's the turning ring.
